section.content: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection probes, and discloses a biological gene detection probe. The detection probe is arranged on the inner wall of the cylinder in a sliding mode, the guide ring is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cylinder, the detection probe is arranged on the inner wall of the guide ring in a sliding mode, a strip-shaped opening is formed in the cylinder wall of the cylinder, and a spiral wire is fixedly connected to the side wall of the detection probe. The drawing detection probe is moved out of the cylinder body, so that the detection probe can be used continuously, the spiral lead is convenient for the detection probe to be connected with equipment, if the detection probe is deviated, the induction plate is pushed to move so as to push the connecting rod and the slide block to move so as to compress the extrusion spring, the guide rod moves so as to ensure that the slide block moves stably, the slide block moves so as to drive the power line to move to be in contact with the wiring end of the alarm, the power supply is used for carrying out electrifying alarm on the alarm, and people using the detection probe can find out in time.

本实用新型涉及检测探针技术领域，且公开了一种生物基因检测探针。包括筒体和检测探针，所述检测探针滑动设置在筒体的内壁，所述筒体的内壁固定连接有导向环，所述检测探针滑动设置在导向环的内壁，所述筒体的筒壁上开设有条形口，所述检测探针的侧壁上固定连接有螺旋导线。本实用新型提供的抽拉检测探针移出至筒体的外侧，使检测探针持续使用，螺旋导线便于检测探针与设备连接，若是检测探针发生偏移会推动感应板移动推动连杆和滑块移动挤压弹簧压缩，导向杆移动保证滑块稳定移动，滑块移动带动电源线移动至与报警器的接线端接触，使电源对报警器进行通电报警，使使用检测探针的人员及时发现。

Biological gene detection probeTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of detection probes, in particular to a biological gene detection probe.

Background

Biological gene detection probes are a tool for detecting specific gene sequences in organisms. These probes are usually a specific DNA or RNA sequence that can be specifically paired with the target gene sequence, and by introducing these probes into a biological sample, the presence of the target gene, or a change in the gene, can be detected by specific experimental methods.

In the prior art, in the use process of the biological gene detection probe, if the detection probe is shifted to respond to the use effect of the subsequent detection probe, the detection probe is damaged if the detection probe is not timely found out due to the shift of the detection probe. Therefore, the utility model designs a biological gene detection probe.

Disclosure of utility model

The utility model aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, in the using process of a biological gene detection probe, if the detection probe is deviated to respond to the using effect of a subsequent detection probe, the detection probe is inclined and damage to the detection probe can be caused if the deviation of the detection probe cannot be found timely.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

The utility model provides a biological gene detection probe, includes barrel and detection probe, the detection probe slides and sets up the inner wall at the barrel, the inner wall fixedly connected with guide ring of barrel, detection probe slides and sets up the inner wall at the guide ring, the bar mouth has been seted up on the section of thick bamboo wall of barrel, fixedly connected with helical wire on the lateral wall of detection probe, helical wire runs through the outside that the bar mouth extends to the barrel, the opening has been seted up to the tip of barrel, detection probe extends to the open-ended inside, the barrel is located the open-ended inner wall and encircles and be equipped with a plurality of induction plates, the barrel is located the open-ended inner wall and encircles and set up a plurality of cavitys, fixedly connected with connecting rod on the lateral wall of induction plate, the inner wall slip of cavity is equipped with the slider, the one end and the slider fixed connection that the connecting rod deviates from the induction plate.

Preferably, the end part of the detection probe is fixedly connected with a pull ring, and the side wall of the cylinder is fixedly connected with a fixing ring.

Preferably, the inner wall of the cylinder is fixedly connected with a supporting ring, the inner wall of the supporting ring is provided with balls in a rolling mode, and the balls are arranged on the side wall of the detection probe in a rolling mode.

Preferably, the cylinder is located the inner wall fixedly connected with spring of cavity, the bottom fixed connection of spring is deviating from one side of connecting rod at the slider, the junction fixedly connected with to guide bar of slider and spring, the pole wall slip setting of guide bar is at the inner wall of cylinder.

Preferably, the inner wall of the cylinder is fixedly connected with a power supply and an alarm, a power line is electrically connected to the side wall of the power supply, the power line extends to the side wall of the sliding block, and a wiring end of the alarm extends to the inner wall of the cylinder, which is located in the cavity.

Preferably, the side wall of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a rubber insulation pad frame, and the side wall of the rubber insulation pad frame is attached to the inner wall of the cylinder body, which is located in the cavity.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a biological gene detection probe, which has the following beneficial effects:

1. This biological gene detection probe shifts out to the outside of barrel through pull detection probe, makes detection probe use continuously, and helical wire is convenient for detect probe and equipment connection, if detection probe takes place the skew and can promote the sensor board and remove the extrusion spring compression of pushing connecting rod and slider removal, and the guide bar removes and guarantee slider steady movement, and slider removal drives the power cord and removes to the wiring end contact with the alarm, makes the power supply carry out the energization warning to the alarm, and the personnel that use detection probe in time discover, prevent that detection probe from damaging, and rubber insulation pad frame prevents the power cord electric leakage.

2. This biological gene detection probe moves detection probe through pulling the pull ring, and the solid fixed ring is convenient for hold the barrel, and the support ring improves detection probe's stability when detection probe removes, and the ball can reduce detection probe's inside friction at the support ring.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of a biological gene detection probe according to the present utility model;

FIG. 2 is an enlarged schematic view of the portion A of FIG. 1;

Fig. 3 is a structural perspective view of the slider of fig. 2.

In the figure, a cylinder body 1, a detection probe 2, a guide ring 3, a spiral lead 4, a pull ring 5, a fixed ring 6, a support ring 7, a ball 8, a sensing plate 9, a connecting rod 10, a sliding block 11, a spring 12, a guide rod 13, a power supply 14, a power supply wire 15, an alarm 16 and a rubber insulation pad frame 17 are arranged.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present utility model will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present utility model, but not all embodiments.

Example 1

Referring to fig. 1-3, a biological gene detection probe, including barrel 1 and detection probe 2, detection probe 2 slides and sets up the inner wall at barrel 1, the inner wall fixedly connected with guide ring 3 of barrel 1, detection probe 2 slides and sets up the inner wall at guide ring 3, the bar mouth has been seted up on the section of thick bamboo wall of barrel 1, fixedly connected with helical wire 4 on the lateral wall of detection probe 2, helical wire 4 runs through the bar mouth and extends to the outside of barrel 1, the opening has been seted up to the tip of barrel 1, detection probe 2 extends to the inside of opening, barrel 1 is located the open-ended inner wall and encircles and be equipped with a plurality of induction plates 9, barrel 1 is located the open-ended inner wall and encircles and set up a plurality of cavitys, fixedly connected with connecting rod 10 on the lateral wall of induction plate 9, the inner wall slip of cavity is equipped with slider 11, the one end that the connecting rod 10 deviates from induction plate 9 and slider 11 fixed connection.

The inner wall that barrel 1 is located the cavity fixedly connected with spring 12, the bottom fixed connection of spring 12 is at the slider 11 side that deviates from connecting rod 10, the junction fixedly connected with to guide bar 13 of slider 11 and spring 12, the pole wall slip setting of guide bar 13 is at the inner wall of barrel 1.

The inner wall fixedly connected with power 14 and alarm 16 of barrel 1, the electricity is connected with power cord 15 on the lateral wall of power 14, and power cord 15 extends to on the lateral wall of slider 11, and the wiring end of alarm 16 extends to the inner wall that barrel 1 is located the cavity, fixedly connected with rubber insulation pad frame 17 on the lateral wall of slider 11, and the laminating of the lateral wall of rubber insulation pad frame 17 sets up the inner wall that is located the cavity at barrel 1.

When the detection probe 2 is pulled to move out of the cylinder 1, the detection probe 2 can be used continuously, the spiral lead 4 is convenient for the detection probe 2 to be connected with equipment, if the detection probe 2 is shifted, the induction plate 9 is pushed to move so as to push the connecting rod 10 and the slide block 11 to move so as to compress the extrusion spring 12, the guide rod 13 is moved so as to ensure the slide block 11 to move stably, the slide block 11 is moved so as to drive the power line 15 to move to be in contact with the wiring end of the alarm 16, the power supply 14 can carry out electrifying alarm on the alarm 16, a person using the detection probe can find out in time, the detection probe 2 is prevented from being damaged, and the rubber insulating pad frame 17 can prevent the power line 15 from leaking.

Example two

Referring to fig. 1-3, a pull ring 5 is fixedly connected to the end of the detection probe 2, a fixing ring 6 is fixedly connected to the side wall of the cylinder 1, a supporting ring 7 is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cylinder 1, balls 8 are arranged on the inner wall of the supporting ring 7 in a rolling manner, and the balls 8 are arranged on the side wall of the detection probe 2 in a rolling manner.

Pulling pull ring 5 can move detection probe 2, and solid fixed ring 6 is convenient for hold barrel 1, and support ring 7 can improve detection probe 2's stability when detection probe 2 removes, and ball 8 can reduce detection probe 2 in the inside friction of support ring 7.

The foregoing is only a preferred embodiment of the present utility model, but the scope of the present utility model is not limited thereto, and any person skilled in the art, who is within the scope of the present utility model, should make equivalent substitutions or modifications according to the technical scheme of the present utility model and the inventive concept thereof, and should be covered by the scope of the present utility model.

1. A biological gene detection probe comprises a barrel body (1) and a detection probe (2) and is characterized in that the detection probe (2) is arranged on the inner wall of the barrel body (1) in a sliding mode, a guide ring (3) is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the barrel body (1), the detection probe (2) is arranged on the inner wall of the guide ring (3) in a sliding mode, a strip-shaped opening is formed in the barrel wall of the barrel body (1), a spiral wire (4) is fixedly connected to the side wall of the detection probe (2), the spiral wire (4) penetrates through the strip-shaped opening to extend to the outer side of the barrel body (1), an opening is formed in the end portion of the barrel body (1), the detection probe (2) extends to the inside of the opening, a plurality of induction plates (9) are arranged on the inner wall of the barrel body (1) in a surrounding mode, a connecting rod (10) is fixedly connected to the side wall of the induction plates (9), a sliding block (11) is arranged on the inner wall of the cavity in a sliding mode, and one end of the connecting rod (10) deviating from the induction plates (9) is fixedly connected with the block (11).</claim-text></claim-text>2. The biological gene detection probe according to claim 1, wherein the end part of the detection probe (2) is fixedly connected with a pull ring (5), and the side wall of the cylinder (1) is fixedly connected with a fixing ring (6).</claim-text></claim-text>3. The biological gene detection probe according to claim 1, wherein the inner wall of the cylinder (1) is fixedly connected with a supporting ring (7), the inner wall of the supporting ring (7) is provided with a ball (8) in a rolling way, and the ball (8) is arranged on the side wall of the detection probe (2) in a rolling way.</claim-text></claim-text>4. The biological gene detection probe according to claim 1, wherein the barrel (1) is fixedly connected with a spring (12) on the inner wall of the cavity, the bottom of the spring (12) is fixedly connected with one side surface of the sliding block (11) deviating from the connecting rod (10), the connecting part of the sliding block (11) and the spring (12) is fixedly connected with a guide rod (13), and the rod wall of the guide rod (13) is slidably arranged on the inner wall of the barrel (1).</claim-text></claim-text>5. The biological gene detection probe according to claim 1, wherein a power supply (14) and an alarm (16) are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cylinder (1), a power line (15) is electrically connected to the side wall of the power supply (14), the power line (15) extends to the side wall of the sliding block (11), and a wiring end of the alarm (16) extends to the inner wall of the cylinder (1) located in the cavity.</claim-text></claim-text>6. The biological gene detection probe according to claim 1, wherein a rubber insulation pad frame (17) is fixedly connected to the side wall of the sliding block (11), and the side wall of the rubber insulation pad frame (17) is attached to the inner wall of the cylinder (1) located in the cavity.</claim-text>
